title: Self-correction keeps only the final choice
transcript:
Ameya: For the session store let's use Redis... actually no, let's go with Memcached instead.
Priya: Works for me.

title: Relative dates resolve against the meeting date (Tuesday 2026-10-27)
transcript:
Ameya: Gowtham, can you ship the auth fix by Wednesday?
Gowtham: Yes, Wednesday works.
Priya: I'll finish the quarterly report by next Monday.

title: Explicit acceptance gets an owner
transcript:
Ameya: Can someone own the load test?
Gowtham: I'll take it, I'll have it done by Thursday.

title: Unassigned work does not get an invented owner
transcript:
Ameya: We really need to rotate the API keys at some point.
Priya: Yeah, agreed.
Gowtham: Definitely.

title: Ambiguous deadline stays unresolved
transcript:
Ameya: Priya, can you update the runbook soon?
Priya: Sure, I'll get to it sometime this month.

title: Investigation-only is not acceptance of ownership
transcript:
Ameya: Does anyone know why the nightly job has been so slow?
Gowtham: I can look into it, no promises.

title: Open discussion is not a decision
transcript:
Priya: Should we move everything to Kubernetes?
Gowtham: Maybe next year, I'm not sure.
Ameya: Let's not decide that now.
